PART I
Item 1. Business
Acme Corp designs, manufactures and sells anvils, rockets and roadrunner-catching devices to customers worldwide. The Company's fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September. Acme sells through its direct online store and third-party retailers in 40 countries.
Item 1A. Risk Factors
The Company's operations are subject to many risks. Demand for anvils is seasonal and depends heavily on cartoon production schedules. Supply of rocket fuel is concentrated among a small number of vendors, and any disruption could adversely affect the Company's results of operations and financial condition.
PART II
Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Net sales increased 12% during 2024 compared to 2023, driven primarily by higher rocket sales in the Americas segment, partially offset by lower anvil sales in Europe. Gross margin improved due to favorable component costs. As discussed in Item 8, net income rose as well.
